content: BIBREF14 have shown that on-line support group therapy increased the quality of life of patients with metastatic breast cancer. Since many original posters reported the benefits of group therapy on patients BIBREF15, BIBREF2, BIBREF16, BIBREF17, BIBREF18, BIBREF7, we evaluate the effect of the user interaction using sentiment scores of comments in on-line support groups.
